messages:
maria_cs: Luma Labs onboarding — their Node SDK init gets a flurry of 429s immediately after ephemeral token exchange. Happening in eu-west-1, env=staging. Blocking QA. Anyone seen handshake/preflight bursts like this?
kevin_onboard: Ack, can you paste the client init logs and their SDK version? Are they firing parallel preflight calls on coldstart? :thinking:
maria_cs: Log snippet from their CI: ```[2025-07-14T15:23:12Z] handshake: ephemeral exchange ok
[2025-07-14T15:23:12Z] preflight_request: start (concurrency=10)
[2025-07-14T15:23:12Z] preflight_response: 429 rate_limiter:preflight
[2025-07-14T15:23:12Z] retry backoff jitter applied```
kevin_onboard: Yep looks like a classic preflight stampede. Which SDK version are they on? Older clients didn't have coalescing.
maria_cs: They shipped 1.2.9 (pinned in package.json).
devx_jordan: OK. Short-term mitigation: ask them to reduce parallel preflight (<=3) and enable splay/jitter. In 1.3.4 we added preflight coalescing and token caching so upgrade is the long-term fix.
kevin_onboard: Can we give them a temporary tenant bump so QA can continue while they upgrade?
ops_sam: I can apply a transient quota/limit increase for their tenant for ~15m. Are we comfortable doing that?
maria_cs: Yes please, helps unblock the customer. Also tell them to set SDK_PREFLIGHT_SPLAY_MS=250 and restart to smooth the initial fanout. Example quick test: ```export SDK_PREFLIGHT_SPLAY_MS=250
node ./examples/start.js```
ops_bot: [automation] tenant_quota_override applied to tenant:luma_labs by ops_sam for 15m (id: qb-7521) :white_check_mark:
maria_cs: Confirmed with Luma — after splay + quota bump their QA run completed and 429s dropped to zero. They will plan the SDK upgrade to 1.3.4 next week.
kevin_onboard: I'll log this in Gainsight (note: temporary quota override, recommend upgrade to 1.3.4, add preflight splay env). Will also email their eng lead with the playbook. :thumbsup:
